login.title: Whick Account Login
login.lead:
Sign in with your Whick account.
During setup you'll see progress, and once complete you'll connect to your Music Server remote.

install.title: Setup in Progress
install.lead: You are signed in. Check your USB setup progress.
install.long_wait: Setup is still running even if it looks frozen for 10+ minutes. Keep this screen open and wait. (Linux/Ubuntu setup can take especially long.)
install.long_hint: Even if the status text is unchanged, the server keeps installing.
install.auto_hint: Once setup completes, you'll be taken to the remote automatically.
install.consent_msg: An existing Whick installation was detected. Do you agree to reinstall?
